rationale: Pivot away from torch_seq_gru_day_gate after 7 consecutive failed iters (#714-#721) exhausted all 5 untried branches without breaking iter #714's 2/7 +28.6% ceiling. xgb_quarterly_dro is the strongest historic non-GRU baseline (iter #589: 6/7 windows, +26.2% avg_ann) — a fundamentally different inductive bias (quarterly distributionally-robust optimization over XGB rather than recurrent state + per-date binary gate) that the recent claude iters have not revisited. Train mode can productively sweep its DRO HPs (rho, n_quarters, alpha) for the next hour while next claude iter designs a genuinely new family (TCN / SSL pretraining / foundation-model PEFT / RL — see lessons).
